scope: Warrior 방패 돌파 후반 접촉·마지막 타격 유지·웹 페이드아웃 재제작

sourcePolicy.rejectedAssetDefect: 기존 시트는 F08-F09에 이미 최대 파쇄가 발생하고 F15-F16이 거의 투명해, 타격이 마지막에 와야 하는 전사 연출 종료 규칙과 맞지 않는다.
sourcePolicy.correctionGoal: 방패의 돌파 쇄도를 F10-F12에 집중하고 F13에서 처음 접촉, F15에서 유일한 최대 파쇄, F16에서 같은 충돌 장면을 유지한다.
sourcePolicy.webEndingPolicy: 웹에서는 F16을 1099ms까지 완전 유지하고 1100-1350ms 동안 선형 페이드아웃한다. 특별한 지시가 없는 이후 전사 스킬 재작업에도 같은 종료 규칙을 사용한다.

commonPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D combat VFX overlay sprite sheet for AlarmQuest. Create exactly 16 chronological animation frames in a strict 4-column by 4-row, row-major sprite sheet. Every cell is one independently clipped wide 361:160 combat viewport; final sheet 1444:640; Detailed hand-painted high-resolution 2D rendering; transparent RGBA; clean antialiased alpha; image-rendering auto; no pixel art. Motion grammar: CONNECTED_SHIELD_RAM_LATE_IMPACT. Keep one fixed camera, one fixed scale, one fixed horizontal attack lane, one fixed contact point P=(74%,58%), and stable object construction. The only equipment is ONE unmistakable connected heavy battle shield: a broad asymmetric convex dark-gunmetal kite/heater shield with a thick chipped rim, reinforced central spine, two shallow dents, and a compact muted blue-gray painted face. The shield is one rigid object in every frame; its silhouette, size, perspective, rim thickness, dents, and painted face never change. No character, arm, hand, body, enemy, or second shield is visible. The attack travels only left-to-right with no vertical bob, camera shake, zoom, reverse motion, rebound, rotation, or redraw wobble. F01 is almost transparent. F02-F06 establish restrained compressed-air glints and one short backward wake around x=12%-28%, with the shield still mostly outside the left crop and no contact flash, cracks, wall, fragments, sparks, or explosion. F07-F09 reveal more of the same shield at the left side while pressure tightens behind it; it remains far from P and nothing is hit. The actual visible ram happens only in three sharply accelerating frames. F10: shield center=(34%,58%). F11: shield center=(50%,58%). F12: shield center=(65%,58%), with its front rim stopping just before P. Preserve identical shield profile, perspective, size, and horizontal angle across F10-F16; translate the whole rigid shield as one unit. Add three to five short tapered translucent blue-gray compression streaks behind it in F10-F12, all parallel to the attack lane, with clean transparent gaps; never form a rectangular speed-line background. F13 is FIRST CONTACT: the front rim strikes P against one narrow dark steel resistance plate, producing one compact ivory-white notch flash and two tiny amber sparks only at P. There must be no earlier contact or full collision. F14 is COMPRESSION: the shield stops dead and remains braced at P; the resistance plate buckles inward, two short cracks appear, and three chunky metal/stone fragments begin moving right. F15 is the UNIQUE MAXIMUM IMPACT: the same readable shield stays planted at P while a decisive but low-tier physical breach erupts forward from its front rim—one compact ivory-white pressure core, a short asymmetric amber-ochre burst, one broken forward wedge, six to eight chunky fragments, and two narrow blue-gray air tears. The impact must project mostly toward the right with a smaller backward pressure wake, remain narrower than half the viewport height, preserve transparent corridors, and never become a full-screen, circular, magical, or ultimate-scale explosion. F16 HOLDS the exact same braced shield and same breach at 75-85% of F15 visual energy, with fragments only slightly farther along their existing trajectories. F16 is not a recovery or fade frame: no rebound, no new blast, no disappearance, and no shield movement. The playback ends on this held impact; the web renderer handles the later 1100-1350ms fade. Keep the top and bottom four pixels of every cell fully transparent. Treat every cell as independently clipped with no adjacent-cell residue. Palette: dark gunmetal, muted steel blue, cold blue-gray compressed air, ivory-white contact core, restrained amber and burnt ochre. Render the shield and attached physical VFX only: no scenery, illustrated ground plane, UI, text, grid, border, gutter, padding, or opaque background.

skills.name: 방패 돌파
skills.generationPrompt: Regenerate '방패 돌파' from scratch as one fast, heavy shield ram whose collision is delayed to the final four frames. Make the single dark-gunmetal shield immediately recognizable and stable without showing a wielder. F02-F09 are restrained anticipation and air compression only; do not reveal a target plate or any impact debris. Snap the same rigid shield rightward through the declared F10, F11, and F12 center positions without rotating or changing its shape. F13 is the first hard rim contact at P, F14 is a brief braced compression, F15 is the one decisive forward breach with compact white-hot pressure, restrained amber sparks, a broken wedge, and chunky fragments, and F16 holds that same physical impact at 75-85% energy. Keep the shield readable through F15-F16, keep all breach energy rooted exactly at its front rim, and leave transparent gaps around the effect. This is a forceful level-10 warrior skill, not an ultimate: prioritize speed, weight, one clear PAK contact, and a solid shield silhouette over magical ornament or screen-filling spectacle.
